final: SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS transaction_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY tr.tradekind
